answer: Yes, the agreement contains an exclusivity obligation regarding the operation of Competitive Businesses. Specifically, if Pretzel Time exercises its right of first refusal, Franchisee agrees that for twelve (12) months commencing on the date of closing, neither Franchisee nor its Owners shall have any interest in any Competitive Business located or operating within three (3) miles of the Unit or three (3) miles of any other Pretzel Time Unit. Additionally, Franchisee must agree not to identify himself or any business as a current or former Pretzel Time Unit or use any Mark or indicia suggesting a connection with Pretzel Time or its Affiliates.
